title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the school year on Monday. School officials placed the school on lockdown out of an abundance of caution, and it later returned to normal operations. The latest threat involved a masked phone number, which follows a pattern seen in recent threats, according to a letter sent to parents by school police.

Gwinnett County Public Schools police are now working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible for the threats. Investigators are looking for the source of the threats. No arrests have been announced and no suspect has been identified. The investigation is ongoing, but authorities have not said what will happen next.
